data.desc: Nextdoor (Nasdaq: NXDR) is the essential neighbourhood network for over 110 million verified neighbours, offering trusted local news, real-time safety alerts, neighbour recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. Nextdoor connects neighbours to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. In addition, businesses, news publishers, and public agencies use Nextdoor to share important information and engage with neighbourhoods at scale. Download the app or join the neighbourhood at nextdoor.ca. For more information and media assets, visit: nextdoor.ca/newsroom.
